label: Bezier handles
intent: Dragging a tangent handle reshapes the curve. Light: the right handle is grabbed (its knob swells), dragged down so the handle pivots on the anchor, and the curve bends through the anchor to follow it a beat later; on release it snaps back past straight and settles. Strong: the handle is nudged up first, then dragged farther so the curve bends deeper, and the release springs back through two decaying swings. The anchor never moves.

curve.//: bend 0 = v1's curve; 1 = the tangent at the anchor turned 32 deg with the handle and lengthened to 4.5 (ends unchanged)

anchor.//: v1's own paths: the rect primitive rounds these 0.6 corners a hair tighter

grab.//: the grabbed knob swells while it is held

bend.//: the curve follows the handle's angle (1 per 32 deg), 40 ms behind
